meta.title: 5 Stoic lessons on mastering your desires

beats.text: Five Stoic lessons on mastering what you want — before it masters you.
One. Every craving is a chance to be ruled. Freedom begins the moment you can say no to it.
Two. Don't seek to have what you want. Learn to want what you already have.
Three. Practise going without, on purpose. Choose the simpler meal, the colder shower — and fear loss less.
Four. The craving always lies. It promises peace, delivers a brief high, then asks for more.
Five. Wealth isn't having endless desires met. It's having few desires in the first place.
Master your wants, said the Stoics, and no person and no circumstance can ever truly own you.
